theorems.name: Submission.bv_lintegral_norm_fderiv_le_of_dual_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Rn n → ℝ) (O L : Set (Rn n)) (M : ℝ≥0∞), ContDiff ℝ 2 w → IsOpen O → IsCompact L → L ⊆ O → (∀ g : Rn n → Rn n, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ O → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal (-∫ x, fderiv ℝ w x (g x)) ≤ M) → ∫⁻ x in L, ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ₑ ≤ M
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
